scope: Stage 4 launch-readiness gates for MVP local/staging handoff

performance.notes: Staging Nginx serves hashed assets with gzip and immutable cache headers. HTTP-only staging still lowers the Lighthouse best-practices score because HTTPS redirection is intentionally not enabled on the standalone port.

accessibility.notes: Core routes expose headings, keyboard reachable actions, non-color-only feedback, reduced motion CSS, and mobile keyboard focus smoke evidence.

backupRestore.notes: Staging pg_dump was restored into wordscodex_restore_drill, migrations were checked, restored counts were read, and the temporary restore database was dropped.

staging.notes: External staging is deployed on a standalone public port. Web, PWA manifest, API health, guest auth, deterministic email-code auth, and vocabulary seed data were verified through the public URL.
